description: The nonzero limit fixed points of left multiplication by omega below omega_1 form a club; for every such delta, level-interval labels lie below delta exactly when their nodes have height below delta.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.fixed_point_coding_club (S : Set Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.BinaryNode)
  (q : ↑S ↪ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne)
  (hq : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.LabelsInLevelIntervals S q) :
  IsClub {δ | Order.IsSuccLimit δ ∧ Ordinal.omega0 * ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ) = ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ)} ∧
    ∀ (δ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne),
      Order.IsSuccLimit δ →
        Ordinal.omega0 * ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ) = ↑(Ordinal.ToType.toOrd δ) → ∀ (t : ↑S), q t < δ ↔ (↑t).fst < δ
